title: 第3章 御姐
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

可能因为用脑过度，司陇今天入睡的很快很沉。

但今天的感觉为什么如此奇怪，明明身体已经陷入深睡状态，但她的思维仍然活跃，甚至可以说......非常清醒。

这种清醒就好像自己想做什么就能做什么......

不如就跟男神做点什么爱做的事吧......

正当她美滋滋地想着，却被脑海中突然出现的画面打断。

嗯？怎么是游戏里的窗口提示界面。

【你已进入永夜梦主游戏世界，请查看你的身份信息。】

姓名：司陇

身份：永夜局梦境稽查处副主任，黎明署头号暗杀名单其中之一，黑市鸦巷长夜典当行幕后二把手。

主线任务：完成永夜局考核升迁为主任干部，同时保护好自己抵御黎明署派来的不明人员暗杀。

“咚咚咚。”

突然传来了敲门声。

司陇下意识地睁开眼睛，看到映入眼帘的一切，她傻了。

不对，这也不是她的小家啊？

面前是一张精致的豪华办公桌，桌上堆叠着一些羊皮纸文件，还有一支插在墨水瓶里的羊毛笔。

最上面一张羊皮纸文件的右下角签名处，龙飞凤舞的签着她的大名，司陇。

和她的字迹一模一样。

地上铺着深棕色带着复古花纹的羊毛地毯，房间不大，墙壁是深色木纹板。

低头看向自己，发现正坐在一张极其舒适的真皮老板椅上。

她连小组长都没当过，就坐上老板椅了？

这个如此豪华的办公室，难道也是自己的？

她的心脏砰砰砰的跳动着，不停回想刚刚看到的一切。

为什么她的名字会和暗杀名单有关联，什么副主任，什么二把手，还有这眼前陌生的一切，她简直要疯了。

但渐渐地，不知是否是房间内的精油香薰太过宜人，一股若有若无的冷杉味，竟令她慢慢平静下来。

最终得出结论，她好像穿越了？

并且是穿到游戏里了！

“咚咚咚。”

敲门声再次响起。

司陇睁开眼后看到的一切让她陷入沉思，不敢轻举妄动，早已经忘记门外还有人在等着回应。

她深吸了一口气，强装镇定地开口，“请进。”

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

Perhaps because of overuse of his brain, Si Long fell asleep very quickly and deeply today.

But why does she feel so strange today? Although her body has fallen into a deep sleep, her mind is still active, and it can even be said...very awake.

This kind of sobriety feels like you can do whatever you want...

Why don't you do something you love with your boyfriend...

Just as she was thinking happily, she was interrupted by a picture that suddenly appeared in her mind.

Um?Why is it the window prompt interface in the game?

[You have entered the Evernight Dream Lord game world, please check your identity information.】

Name: Si Long

Identity: Deputy director of the Dream Investigation Division of the Evernight Bureau, one of the top assassination lists of the Dawn Bureau, and the second-in-command behind the Long Night Pawn Shop in Crow Alley, a black market.

Main mission: Complete the assessment of the Evernight Bureau and be promoted to chief cadre, while protecting yourself against assassinations by unknown persons sent by the Dawn Bureau.

"Dong dong dong."

Suddenly there was a knock on the door.

Si Long opened her eyes subconsciously and was stunned when she saw everything that came into view.

No, this isn’t her little home either?

In front of him was an exquisite luxurious desk, with some parchment documents stacked on it and a woolen pen inserted in an inkwell.

At the signature place in the lower right corner of the top parchment document, her name, Si Long, was signed with flying phoenixes.

It's exactly the same as her handwriting.

The floor is covered with a dark brown wool carpet with retro patterns. The room is small and the walls are made of dark wood grain boards.

Looking down at himself, he found that he was sitting on an extremely comfortable leather boss chair.

She didn't even serve as a team leader, and yet she sat on the boss's chair?

Does this luxurious office also belong to you?

Her heart was beating loudly as she kept thinking about what she had just seen.

Why was her name related to the assassination list, the deputy director, the second-in-command, and everything unfamiliar in front of her, she was going crazy.

But gradually, she didn't know whether the essential oil aroma in the room was too pleasant, but a faint smell of fir made her slowly calm down.

Finally came to the conclusion that she seems to have traveled through time?

And it’s worn into the game!

"Dong dong dong."

The knock on the door sounded again.

What Si Long saw when she opened her eyes made her fall into deep thought, and she did not dare to act rashly. She had long forgotten that there was someone waiting for a response outside the door.

She took a deep breath and said calmly, "Please come in."
